messages.subject: Re: Generate Rating Scale Model(RSM) item response data using SIMDATA function in 'mirt' package
parts:
Please use the mirt-package google forum for questions like these in the future. I've forwarded this question to the forum for others to benefit from as well.

The RSM is just a special case of the GPCM when all a1 parameters are equal (or equivalently set to 1 and the latent variance term is something other than 1), though it's often specified with thresholds rather than intercepts. Below is an example of transforming thresholds to intercept parameters via traditional2mirt() and simulating the data that way. Just modify the following example and replace the values as you need:

#make some data
set.seed(1234)
a <- matrix(1, 10)
b <- matrix(c(-1.5, 0, 1.5), 10, 3, byrow = TRUE)
c <- seq(0, 2, length.out=10)
bprime <- b + c
si <- t(apply(bprime, 1,
      function(x) traditional2mirt(x = c(a=1, b=x), 'gpcm', ncat=4)))
data <- simdata(si[,1], si[,6:9], 2000, itemtype = rep('gpcm',10))

mod1 <- mirt(data, 1, 'Rasch')
coef(mod1, simplify=TRUE, IRTpars=TRUE) # compare to bprime
mod2 <- mirt(data, 1, itemtype = 'rsm')
coef(mod2, simplify=TRUE)
anova(mod2, mod1) #not sig, mod2 should be preferred
itemplot(mod2, 1)
itemplot(mod2, 10)

Phil
